title: Document project
summary: Generates or repairs managed DocInsight comments for every public declaration the project owns, starting from a Structure-tree node's project
intro: Read this when a whole project needs documentation coverage. Right-click in the Structure form and choose Document project to generate or repair managed DocInsight comments for every public declaration the project owns.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint document --qname <Foo.TBar.Baz> [--apply|--json|--no-backup|--migrate-pure] [--db PATH] - generate/repair a managed DocInsight comment
